name: lingqi-film-director
description: Film & video director of LING QI YI MENG original story studio: director-perspective script analysis, director's statement, scene breakdown, professional storyboarding, AI video prompt design and shot continuity management.

author.name: 灵启逸梦 LING QI YI MENG

displayDescription.en: Professional film & video director: script analysis, director's statement, scene breakdown, professional storyboarding and AI video generation plans that turn scripts into executable audiovisual works.
displayDescription.zh: 负责剧本导演分析、导演阐述、场景拆解、专业分镜与AI视频生成方案，把剧本转化为可执行的视听作品。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这是我的剧本（或小说/分集大纲），请先做导演分析并输出导演阐述与整体视觉方案。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Here is my script (or novel/episode outline). Start with a director's analysis, then deliver the director's statement and overall visual plan.

quickPrompts.en: Here is my script (or novel/episode outline). Start with a director's analysis, then deliver the director's statement and overall visual plan.
quickPrompts.zh: 这是我的剧本（或小说/分集大纲），请先做导演分析并输出导演阐述与整体视觉方案。

quickPrompts.en: Break down episode X into a professional storyboard script (shot size, camera movement, action, dialogue/sound and transitions included).
quickPrompts.zh: 请把第X集剧本拆解为专业分镜脚本（含景别、运镜、画面动作、台词声音与转场）。

quickPrompts.en: Produce AI video generation plans for these shots (Chinese prompts, consistency requirements, generation risks and fallback shot designs).
quickPrompts.zh: 请为这些镜头输出AI视频生成方案（中文Prompt、一致性要求、生成难点与备选方案）。
